realpath.reason: No native symlink/readlink/canonical-path operation. VFS accepts validated absolute paths only; native stat exposes only File and Directory. Lexically stripping dot/dot-dot could skip nonexistent components and cannot supply filesystem-aware canonicalization or permission traversal.
realpath.missing_primitive: An authoritative native path resolver with component traversal, permissions, cwd and symlink semantics; no Linux-ABI syscall substitution.
realpath.permission_error_validation: NOT_RUN for realpath; no implementation exists

stat.existing_C_fstat: Existing symbol consumes the 24-byte native wire structure, not a POSIX struct stat. Do not change its destination size silently or pass an invented POSIX layout.
stat.lstat: BLOCKED: no native symlink model or no-follow metadata operation.
stat.zero_field_policy: No fields synthesized and no new POSIX stat ABI advertised.

error_mapping.other native fstat failures: Kernel can collapse to generic failure; libc maps EIO. No more precise claim.

coverage: mkstemp empty regular file, mode 0600, nlinks
